title: Coinbase and Broadridge Propose Wallet-Based Shareholder Communications Standard
why_it_matters: Tokenized equities need more than a trading and settlement mechanism: issuers must reach beneficial owners with notices and investors need usable governance channels. A shared wallet communications format could reduce fragmented integrations, although legal entitlements and adoption still depend on each security structure.
caption:
RWA WIRE // NEWS

Coinbase and Broadridge Propose Wallet-Based Shareholder Communications Standard

Coinbase and Broadridge published a proposed Ethereum standard for delivering shareholder materials to tokenized-share wallets, while Broadridge launched an oracle to document distribution.
